sources.title: TUTORIAL: Dedicated Server Windows (2016) - config.txt field list
Ballistic Overkill Steam patch notes mirror - 1.4.1, 27 Sep 2017: "Fixed admin commands not working. If you're in a server you own/host, type ./help to see all commands."
LinuxGSM boserver _default.cfg - appid 416880, unity3d, querytype protocol-valve, no rcon settings
LinuxGSM - Ballistic Overkill Linux Game Server
Admin tools / commands for dedicated servers?! - developer reply on webadmin tooling
SteamDB - Ballistic Overkill Dedicated Server (AppID 416880, type Tool)

notes: No command channel a server manager can reach. BODS (SteamCMD app 416880, Unity, started as BODS.exe / ./BODS.x86_64 -batchmode -nographics -dedicated -configfile=config.txt) exposes no RCON, no admin HTTP API, and no documented stdin command parser; config.txt holds only ServerName, ServerPort, QueryPort, MaxPlayers, MaxSpectators, MaxPing, GameMap, GameMode, MatchTime, Password, BannerURL, ClickURL, Autobalance, DedicatedBroadcast and OwnerId - there is no RCON enable/port/password setting. LinuxGSM's boserver config carries no rcon fields either and queries the server with the Valve A2S protocol only (QueryPort default 27016), which is read-only. The game's only moderation path is in-game CHAT commands typed by the player whose SteamID64 is set as config.txt OwnerId while connected to the server as a client: ./help, ./list (numbers every player in the match), ./kick <number>, ./blacklist <number> (permanent ban on that server) and ./prioritylist <number>. Patch 1.4.1 (27 Sep 2017) confirms the form: "Fixed admin commands not working. If you're in a server you own/host, type ./help to see all commands." They are deliberately NOT recorded as commands here for two reasons: they are client-side chat input with no server-side pipe to send them down, and they address players by their transient position in the ./list output rather than by any stable identifier, so a stored template could not be filled in safely. For the same reason no playerId is recorded. A 2017 developer reply to a request for webadmin kick/ban tooling said only "we do want to elaborate more the dedicated servers tools in the future"; nothing shipped. No hosting provider page found claims RCON for this game. Context: official servers were shut down 2020-01-31 and the game was delisted from Steam 2023-02-13, though the dedicated-server tool is still downloadable anonymously and community servers still run.
